title: Biblical World Atlas — External Research Source Directory
note: Links identify resources; a listed resource is not a packaged file in this repository. Rights and direct download conditions depend on the source.

sources.name: Waldseemüller World Map (1507)
sources.resource: Original digitized map and image downloads
sources.note: Twelve-sheet world map; original date 1507. The archive provides viewing and download options.
sources.files: Images at source; no images hosted by atlas

sources.name: Urbano Monte Planisphere (1587)
sources.resource: High-resolution historical map viewer and research article
sources.note: Digital assemblage of the 60-sheet 1587 manuscript; original view and specialized derivative downloads.
sources.files: Large map imagery and related files at source

sources.name: Fra Mauro World Map (c. 1450)
sources.resource: Original manuscript catalog and historical map resources
sources.note: Venetian manuscript map. Institution documents provenance and related digital access.

sources.name: Library of Congress Geography and Map Division
sources.resource: Map database, individual scans and item-level downloads
sources.note: Historical world, regional, and thematic map collection; download options and rights vary by item.

sources.name: David Rumsey Historical Map Collection
sources.note: Maps from multiple centuries with detailed catalog records and high-resolution viewers.
sources.files: Source-hosted maps and downloads where allowed

sources.name: Antarctica Overview Map
sources.resource: Modern polar map with downloadable cartography
sources.note: Prepared 2022, published 2025; WGS84 Antarctic polar stereographic projection, source and licensing notes included.
sources.files: Original map downloads at source; OGL 3.0 attribution applies

sources.name: Landsat Image Mosaic of Antarctica (LIMA)
sources.note: Satellite-derived composite with multiple views, projection information, and coverage notes.
sources.files: Viewer; larger image products accessed separately

sources.name: LIMA Satellite Image Downloads
sources.resource: GeoTIFF satellite image data and download metadata
sources.note: Source offers geographic data files and metadata; full-resolution downloads may be large.

sources.name: Bible Translation Library
sources.resource: Translation finder and Bible passage source links
sources.note: Choose from linked Bible versions. Modern copyrighted translations open at authorized reading sites.
sources.files: Online reading links; full-text copies not included in atlas

sources.name: Ancient Writings and Ethiopian Canon
sources.resource: Historical text readers and canonical references
sources.note: 1, 2, 3 Enoch reading sources, Jubilees, Jasher, manuscript resources, Ethiopian canon references.
sources.files: Text reading hosted by original sources

sources.name: Historical Study-Bible Map Library
sources.resource: Historical map catalog and Scripture cross-references
sources.note: 1888 historical map plates with source attribution and passage links.
sources.files: Original image files hosted by source institution

sources.name: Plants of the World Online
sources.note: Modern taxonomy can help investigate possible ancient plant identifications; not proof of biblical species.

sources.name: What Is Soil?
sources.note: Information about soil materials and formation, not proof of an ancient term's meaning.

sources.name: USGS Gemstone Terminology
sources.note: Modern gemstone classification for comparing historical names, with uncertainty recognized.

sources.name: Biblical Nature, Foods and Earth Materials
sources.note: Fruits, vegetables, herbs, clay, soil, rocks, metals and gemstones with evidence labels.
